LanguageData.LP_DragonBody_Red.label: true dragon body (red)
LanguageData.LP_DragonBody_Red.description: The body of a true dragon: needs no food or sleep, never has mental breaks on its own (externally caused mental states are handled by legendary resistance), immune to its own color's element. The breath has a 1/3 chance to recharge every 6 seconds. Dies when downed; cannot be captured.
